messages:
alex: Heads up — saw repeated OOMs on prod-inference after allocator defaults bump in #runtime deploy yesterday. Root: 1769123456

maria: Ack. Which knobs changed?

alex: expandable_segments toggled to true, max_split_size_mb lowered from 256->64, GC threshold left at 0.25. Saw OOM on a 5k token KV refill path.

sam: Can you paste the perf trace? flamegraph? :eyes: 

alex: ```
[PID 1234] CUDA OOM when allocating 1.2GB at runtime::alloc
alloc_chain: large split created, couldn't find segment >1.2GB
heap_summary: free=1.0GB largest=512MB
stack: runtime::kv_refill -> runtime::decode -> runtime::alloc
``` 

jin: That matches split fragmentation — lowering max_split_size_mb created more splits, leading to fragmentation under high KV cache churn.

logan: Quick mitigation: set max_split_size_mb back to 256 and increase garbage_collection_threshold to 0.6 for a few hours. Also try workspace prealloc to 1.5x model_kv_peak.

maria: Agree. We should also test expandable_segments=false to avoid dynamic splits for now.

alex: Ran canary with max_split_size_mb=256 + gc_threshold=0.6 + expandable_segments=false. Results: no OOMs across 2h stress; p50 latency +3ms; cost +0.8%.

infra-bot: perf-run 1769123600 complete: 2h stress, 0 OOMs, mean latency 142ms (baseline 139ms)

sam: Good. Follow-up: add a regression test in perf harness to simulate KV churn and measure fragmentation. We need a profiler snippet in CI.

jin: I'll add an orthogonal fix: improve buffer reuse logic for KV cache evictions to reduce transient peak allocations. Patch will try to reuse per-stream scratch buffers before allocating new.

alex: Patch branch: pr/4922 adjusting defaults + perf test. @maria can you review?

maria: on it. Also create playbook entry: steps to roll back knobs and run bench script. Suggest doc include commands: 

```
# rollback knobs
./infra/ctl set-knob --name max_split_size_mb --value 256
./infra/ctl set-knob --name garbage_collection_threshold --value 0.6
./infra/ctl set-knob --name expandable_segments --value false
# run stress bench
./bench/inference_load_test.sh --kv-churn --duration 7200
```

alex: Created docs/playbooks/allocator-oom.md stub in repo and linked in the PR.

logan: FWIW, longer-term: consider allocator that coalesces small free segments to defragment, or track per-stream preallocation. Might be a medium-term runtime change.

sam: Agreed. We'll track as roadmap item and add a perf ticket for fragmentation tests.

alex: Thanks all :thumbsup:
